messages.moduleDeleted: Module deleted. Its lessons are kept, without a module.
messages.domainDeleted: Domain deleted. Its modules are kept, without a domain.
messages.seedImported: Added {{lessons}} lessons and {{modules}} modules. {{skipped}} lessons already existed and were left unchanged.
messages.syllabusImported: Added {{domains}} domains, {{modules}} modules and {{lessons}} lessons. Existing items were left unchanged.
messages.errNotInstalled: The database is not up to date: the corpus tables are missing. Ask the technical team to apply the migrations.
messages.errPermission: Not allowed: the administrator role is required.
messages.errConflict: Someone else changed this lesson since you opened it. Reload the page to get the latest version, then redo your changes.
messages.errInvalid: Value refused: check links and numbers.
messages.errNetwork: The server is not responding. Check your connection and try again.
messages.aiQuota: Daily AI limit reached. Try again tomorrow.
messages.aiTooLarge: The request sent to the AI is too long. Shorten the content and try again.
messages.aiFailed: The AI service could not answer. Try again in a moment.
messages.aiBadAnswer: The AI answer could not be read. Try again.
messages.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 25 MB.
messages.unsafeLink: The link must start with http:// or https://.
